scope: Unified persisted driver performance projection for dispatch, driver UI and administrative readers

current.driverUi: GET /driver/performance?rules=4 executes readPerformance per request on the server; no modern persisted aggregate written
current.dispatch: Reads legacy metricsSnapshot fields from WizzDriverLiveState_staging

design.authoritativeFacts: Immutable verified offer responses/display receipts, assignment outcomes, administrative decisions/appeals and verified rating review records
design.sharedReadModel: Persisted per-driver versioned aggregate with rates, numerator/denominator, coverage/status per indicator, policy version, source watermark, computedAt and refresh status
design.updates: Event-driven idempotent recomputation outside wave request path, plus reconciliation and scheduled refresh for rolling-window expiry
design.concurrency: Deduplicate source events, coalesce bursts and publish conditionally so older workers cannot overwrite newer snapshots
design.consumers: Dispatch, performance UI and admin read the same version; drill-down event history is paged separately
design.freshness: Bounded freshness and explicit pending/stale status; no invented perfect/zero score and no automatic adverse attribution from missing history
design.rollout: Backfill, compare against current verified calculator, shadow dispatch, then controlled activation; preserve evidence-based exceptions, appeals and small-sample policy
